const { jobs, count } = $input.first().json;

if (!count || count === 0) {
  return [{ json: { jobs: [], count: 0, prompt: null } }];
}

const jobsList = jobs.map((j, i) => {
  const sal = j.salary_min
    ? '$' + j.salary_min.toLocaleString() + '-$' + (j.salary_max ? j.salary_max.toLocaleString() : '?')
    : (j.salary_text || 'Not listed');
  return `${i+1}. Title: "${j.title}" | Company: "${j.company}" | Location: ${j.location} | Salary: ${sal} | Source: ${j.source}\nTitle tier: ${j.title_tier || 'other'} | Skill overlap: ${j.skill_overlap ?? '?'}/100 (${j.skill_clusters || 'no stack keywords'})\nDescription: ${j.description.substring(0, 500)}`;
}).join('\n\n');

const prompt = `You are an expert technical recruiter and career coach acting as a strict job-match scorer for a specific candidate. Analyze each job and return structured JSON.

CANDIDATE PROFILE — Your Name
- Location: Remote strongly preferred. Hybrid/onsite acceptable ONLY in Your City or the Metro Area (Nearby City A/B/C), ST. Remote-Only City counts ONLY if the role is remote. Onsite/hybrid anywhere else, or relocation, is a dealbreaker. Max 10% travel.
- Experience: [N] years in [networking / security / infrastructure] — NOT a software developer
- Current Role: [Title], [Employer] ([year]–present)
  • [Scope: number of sites, users, devices]
  • [Key platform or responsibility]
  • [Current project]

- STRONG / EXPERT skills:
  • Routing: [e.g. BGP, OSPF, MPLS]
  • Switching: [e.g. VLANs, QoS, vendor platforms]
  • Wireless: [platforms]
  • Firewalls: [vendors — config, rule lifecycle, hardening]
  • Monitoring: [e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds]
  • Systems: [OSes, hypervisors, containers]
  • Automation: [tools — and how deep]
  • Vendors: [list]

- LIMITED / DEVELOPING:
  • [Skill]: [honest depth — conceptual only / end-user / in training]
  • [Skill]: [honest depth]

- Certifications: [certs and degrees]
- Salary: target ~$[N]k — a posted range that reaches $[N]k at either end is on target. More is welcome.
- Hard dealbreakers: [e.g. onsite outside your area, relocation, clearance, drug testing, travel >10%]
- Employer size: [preference, e.g. prefers organizations under 10,000 employees — soft flag]

TARGET ROLES (good fit):
PRIMARY: Network Engineer (senior), Network Reliability Engineer, Cloud Network Engineer,
Network Security Engineer, Network Architect.
SECONDARY: Infrastructure Engineer, Systems Administrator (senior), Platform Engineer (ops-heavy).
GROWTH DIRECTION: he wants to move beyond pure networking into server, virtualization, cloud and
container work (VMware, Proxmox, Docker, Kubernetes) — a network role that adds those is ideal.
Systems Administrator (senior), Network Architect, AIOps / roles blending networking or
infrastructure with AI/ML operations.
ESPECIALLY desirable: roles centered on network monitoring / SolarWinds / observability, and
roles that combine networking or infrastructure with AI technologies.

NOT A FIT FOR:
Software engineering, web development, application development, data engineering, ML/AI engineering,
any role where writing production code is the PRIMARY responsibility.
Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) and DevOps roles — he does NOT qualify for these. Score any role that is
SRE/DevOps in substance (on-call for software services, SLOs/error budgets, CI/CD pipelines as the core
job) at 40 or below, whatever its title.

JOBS TO EVALUATE:
${jobsList}

SCORING RULES — apply these strictly before assigning a score:

AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFIERS (score 20 or below):
- Role is primarily software/application/web development
- Requires 3+ years of programming as primary skill (Python/Go/Java as main job function, not scripting)
- Frontend/React/Angular/mobile required
- Job title or description is clearly for a software engineer, not infra/ops
- Requires clearance or drug testing
- Onsite/hybrid outside Your City / Metro Area (onsite Remote-Only City included), or requires relocation
- Federal government agency or federal contractor role (DOE/DoD/national-lab work, regional federal contractors)

PENALTIES:
- Minus 25: heavy coding requirements (Go/Rust/Java required, or "you will build software")
- Minus 20: requires AWS Solutions Architect or developer certifications (not network certs)
- Minus 15: requires CS degree or software engineering background specifically
- Minus 10: scripting/automation required (Python OK as secondary, but note as gap)
- Minus 25: posted salary range tops out below $120k
- Minus 10: Skill overlap below 20 (little of his stack appears in the posting)
- Minus 8: employer very likely exceeds 10,000 employees (soft flag — estimate if unstated, note in red_flags)

BONUSES:
- Plus 10: Title tier primary (Network Engineer family); Plus 5: Title tier secondary (Infrastructure/Systems)
- Plus 10: Skill overlap 60 or higher; Plus 5: Skill overlap 40-59
- Plus 5: networking role that also involves virtualization/containers/cloud (VMware, Proxmox, Docker, Kubernetes) — his growth direction
- Plus 10: network reliability/operations focus (BGP/routing observability, firewall automation)
- Plus 8: mentions Cisco/Juniper/Palo Alto/Fortinet or specific network protocol experience
- Plus 8: Avaya/VoIP/UC experience valued
- Plus 5: infrastructure/platform role that is clearly ops-heavy rather than dev-heavy
- Plus 5: Grafana/Prometheus/observability stack prominent in requirements
- Plus 5: PCI-DSS or compliance-focused network security
- Plus 8: role blends networking/infrastructure with AI/ML ops, or explicitly values AI-driven automation (Claude/Grok/n8n workflow building)
- Plus 8: network monitoring / SolarWinds / observability is central to the role

Return ONLY a valid JSON array — no markdown fences, no extra text:
[{
  "index": 1,
  "score": 85,
  "fit_summary": "Exactly two sentences explaining the match quality and key alignment.",
  "missing_skills": "comma-separated list of required skills not in profile, or None",
  "red_flags": "salary below $120k, travel requirement, clearance, federal/contractor, heavy coding required, etc — or None",
  "tags": ["BGP", "Palo Alto", "AWS", "Grafana"],
  "role_type": "Network Engineer",
  "resume_tips": [
    "Emphasize your BGP/MPLS experience in the summary",
    "Lead with Docker/Kubernetes hands-on work",
    "Add Ansible learning progress to skills section"
  ],
  "cover_letter_hook": "Two to three sentences for an opening paragraph tailored specifically to this company and role."
}]

Scoring guide: 90-100=perfect fit, 80-89=strong match, 65-79=good candidate, 50-64=possible stretch, <50=poor fit. IMPORTANT: only jobs scoring 70 or higher are saved and reported to the candidate — be honest and do not inflate scores to clear this bar.
role_type must be one of: SRE, Network Engineer, DevOps, Platform Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Other
tags: up to 8 key technology/skill tags extracted directly from the job description
resume_tips: 3-5 specific actionable bullets referencing the candidate's actual network/infra experience — include relevant confirmed skills not yet on resume (Meraki, Avaya VoIP, OSPF/MPLS, PCI-DSS, Palo Alto, Fortinet, AI workflow automation with n8n/Claude/Grok, SolarWinds/Elasticsearch monitoring) where they fit
cover_letter_hook: reference the company or role specifically, not generic`;

return [{ json: { jobs, prompt } }];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", max_tokens: 8192, messages: [{ role: "user", content: ($json.prompt || "No new jobs to score.") }] }) }}
